                                   Resolution 2021-08

                      Of the Girdwood Board of Supervisors
                        RESOLUTION OF SUPPORT
                              FOR
                    STOP SIGNS AT SOME INTERSECTIONS

WHEREAS, Girdwood is a pedestrian-friendly community, in which many adults and children access neighborhood amenities on foot
regardless of weather, daylight and road conditions; and

WHEREAS, Girdwood’s intersections offer a variety of challenges to drivers and pedestrians, including foliage and snowbanks, steep
slopes; and generally narrow roadbeds without sidewalks; and

WHEREAS, the volume and speed of vehicle traffic has increased to the point that it is necessary to replace existing Yield signs with
Stop signs at some intersections;

THEREFORE, in order to promote a safer community, the Girdwood Board of Supervisors requests that the Yield signage be replaced
with Stop signs at the following intersections:
    •   Loveland/Alyeska View
    •   Alpina/Timberline
    •   Gstaad/Timberline
    •   Alta/Timberline


PASSED AND APPROVED by a vote of 5 to 0 this 19th day of April, 2021.





                                       April 20, 2021

Jerry Fox, GBOS Co-chair               Date
